title: Mcp Payload Surface For Compose Design Split Viewer
description: Add engine surface field and UI effectiveSurface so start_working_in_design mounts ComposeDesign not ComposeDiagram when hosts merge stale show-diagram with points.
summary: Engine: added `surface` to MCP app payloads (`design`/`scene`/`diagram`) via _mcp_app_surface_for_mode. UI: McpDiagramPayload.surface, normalize + score + merge (with design-rich candidate copying surface); McpDesignViewer branches on effectiveSurface so ComposeDesign mounts for split view even when stale merged mode is show-diagram with non-empty points. Extended engine tests for surface. pytest + vitest pass.
